title: Opening Kesuvos: the match made in Heaven
summary: The first shiur on Masechta Kesuvos: what the word kesubah means, why a person's zivug is the one thing he doesn't choose, and why Heaven calls out "the daughter of so-and-so." Why a besulah is married on Wednesday, why our fingers are shaped like pegs that can close the ears, why the chosson and kallah cry under the chuppah, and how even the unborn sang shirah at the Yam Suf.
